headlines.text: Trump says 'threat' led US to pull bombers from RAF Fairford. The Pentagon confirmed on Sunday it had removed the B1 bombers from the base in England back to their home stations in America.

Saudi Arabia urged to spare man sentenced to death over Facebook post. Anojan Sivarasa faces execution after he was found guilty of blasphemy over a Facebook comment.
Separatist party projected to win Quebec election, adding new test to Canada's unity. The Parti Québécois, which secured a minority, has vowed to hold an independence referendum in the years to come.
